The '''Imperial Intelligence Gadget Warehouse''' was an installation of the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] located on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Sith Empire.<ref name="TOR:IIGW" />
